title: Alan Fontus First Meeting

nodes.speaker: Alan Fontus
nodes.text: It's nice to see a young person like yourself keeping the art of 'walking up to strangers' alive.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: It's nice to see a young person like yourself keeping the art of 'walking up to strangers' alive.

nodes.speaker: Alan Fontus
nodes.text: It shouldn't be but I've seen it happen less and less with every generation.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: It shouldn't be but I've seen it happen less and less with every generation.

nodes.speaker: Alan Fontus
nodes.text: Age is just a number. Some measure it in years, some in generations. Personally I measure it in mitochondrial mutations. Hey you knew Thaddeus right?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Age is just a number. Some measure it in years, some in generations. Personally I measure it in mitochondrial mutations. Hey you knew Thaddeus right?

nodes.speaker: Alan Fontus
nodes.text: Ahhhh that's right! Thaddeus is still alive, in his own way. But aren't we all?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Ahhhh that's right! Thaddeus is still alive, in his own way. But aren't we all?

nodes.speaker: Alan Fontus
nodes.text: That's something I'm not sure either you, nor the rest of the world is ready to hear yet. And I'm certainly not sure if I'm ready to tell.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: That's something I'm not sure either you, nor the rest of the world is ready to hear yet. And I'm certainly not sure if I'm ready to tell.

nodes.speaker: Alan Fontus
nodes.text: That might be the question! The only one worth asking.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: That might be the question! The only one worth asking.

nodes.speaker: Alan Fontus
nodes.text: When the day comes that the people of this city are ready to fight God, perhaps they might be trusted with the tools to do so.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: When the day comes that the people of this city are ready to fight God, perhaps they might be trusted with the tools to do so.

nodes.speaker: Alan Fontus
nodes.text: Your impatience illustrates my exact point about readiness.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Your impatience illustrates my exact point about readiness.

nodes.speaker: Alan Fontus
nodes.text: Perhaps there is hope for you yet... we'll see.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Perhaps there is hope for you yet... we'll see.

nodes.speaker: Alan Fontus
nodes.text: I apologize, the moon is young to me.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I apologize, the moon is young to me.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Young person?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Young person?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I didn't know that was an art.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I didn't know that was an art.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I didn't know that was an art.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I didn't know that was an art.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Generations? You must be older than you look.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Generations? You must be older than you look.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Generations? You must be older than you look.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Generations? You must be older than you look.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Knew? I still know him.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Knew? I still know him.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What was that about mitochondria?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What was that about mitochondria?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You talk in riddles.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You talk in riddles.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: When will we be ready to learn what you're talking about?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: When will we be ready to learn what you're talking about?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: When will we be ready to learn what you're talking about?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: When will we be ready to learn what you're talking about?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Maybe we're not ready.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Maybe we're not ready.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: That sounds like a lot of responsibility.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: That sounds like a lot of responsibility.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: That sounds like a lot of responsibility.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: That sounds like a lot of responsibility.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You must be older than you look.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You must be older than you look.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: You must be older than you look.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: You must be older than you look.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I... feel ready.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I... feel ready.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Can you just get to the point?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Can you just get to the point?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Can you just get to the point?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Can you just get to the point?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Right...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Right...

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I can't wait to get the God-fighting tools that you don't currently trust me with.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I can't wait to get the God-fighting tools that you don't currently trust me with.
